name: PT Menthobi Karyatama Raya Tbk
summary: PT Menthobi Karyatama Raya Tbk engages in the cultivation and development of palm oil plantations; and crude palm oil processing activities and related derivative products primarily in Indonesia. The company is involved in the rental of heavy equipment; and provision of waste management, logistics, and technical and managerial consulting services. It also provides palm kernel and fresh fruit bunches; and management services, as well as develops and manages plasma plantations. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Jakarta Timur, Indonesia.
